description: Use to see the watches on the signed-in account, each with its settings and the id that watch_change, watch_stop and watch_details take. kind flight: route, dates, cabin, each itinerary's current price against the price when tracking began, its search_key and fids. hotel: stay dates, guests, each hotel's current price against the price when tracking began, its tracking_id and hotel_ids. seat: flight, departure, cabin, the seats watched and which are open now, its tracking_key. bucket_list: flight and hotel bucket lists with the best deals found so far, each bucket_id. Leave kind out to see every kind.

currency.description: [flight, hotel, bucket_list] The traveler's currency, when they name one or their words show where they live (euros in Spain, or writing in French from Lyon). Empty: US dollars or their SlickTrip currency. Amounts you send stay US dollars.

kind.description: Which kind to list: flight (tracked flights), hotel (tracked stays), seat (seat alerts) or bucket_list (flight and hotel bucket lists). Leave out for every kind.

limit.description: How many of each kind to return, newest first.

name.description: [bucket_list] Only the bucket lists the traveler asked about: words from a list's name or its places, e.g. 'Firefall' or 'Lisbon'. Leave out to list them all.

name: watch_list

bucket_lists.description: Flight items (bucket_id, kind, route fields, months, window, nights, price, best_deals...) and hotel items (location, nights, adults, months, best_deals...)

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

count.description: flight: Number of flight trackings on the account; hotel: Number of hotel stays tracked; seat: Number of seat alerts on the account; bucket_list: Number of bucket lists returned

manage_url.description: flight: slicktrip.com saved-flights page link; hotel: slicktrip.com saved-hotels page link; seat: slicktrip.com saved-seats page link; bucket_list: slicktrip.com saved-buckets page link

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: flight: How to stop a tracking; hotel: How to stop a tracking; seat: How to stop a seat alert; bucket_list: How to remove; price semantics

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

trackings.description: flight: Items: route fields, search_key, alert_preference, alert_method, prices, last_alert_sent, itineraries[], manage_url; hotel: Items: tracking_id, name, check_in, check_out, adults, children, alert settings, prices, hotels[], manage_url; seat: Items: tracking_key, flight_number, origin, destination, departure_time, aircraft, cabins, seats_together, tracked_seats, open_now, alert_method, created_at, manage_url

watches.description: With no kind: every kind's answer under its kind (flight, hotel, seat, bucket_list), each as watch_list with that kind returns it

title: List watches
